description: Canonical Alert — the only thing that crosses L2 NORMALIZE → L3 DECIDE-1 (contract C2). The anti-corruption rule is structural: Alert.raw (the full vendor payload) and Alert.source (vendor identity) are stripped at the edge and DO NOT cross — enforced below by the 'not' clause, not by prose. The decision core therefore never sees foreign shapes (hexagonal rule; deterministic-gate.md P4). The fingerprint identity inputs (service, check, severity_in, labels.env/cluster/region) cross because they are the canonical identity, not vendor shape. additionalProperties:true is the Tolerant Reader rule for in-repo evolution (e.g. correlator.md P8's additive signals); unknown fields are ignored by consumers.

not.description: Anti-corruption: neither the vendor payload nor the vendor identity crosses into the decision core.

alert_id.description: Stable alert identity: caller-supplied dedup_key/alert_id, else the fingerprint.

breach_duration_s.description: How long the breach held, seconds; null when not a metric alert.

check.description: What is being checked — fingerprint identity input.

fingerprint.description: ADR-017 scheme v2: sha256('service|check|severity_in|region|env|cluster')[:16]. env and cluster are required keyword-only at mint time — no call site may silently mint an env-blind hash.

labels.description: String labels. env/cluster/region SHOULD be present: they are fingerprint-identity inputs, and label drift silently forks dedup identity (correlator.md M9). An empty value is the 'unknown' namespace, never a wildcard. Tightening these to required is a v0.2 candidate — see README (F2 draft churn).

metric_threshold.description: The breached threshold, if any; null otherwise.

metric_value.description: The observed metric value, if any; null otherwise.

received_at.description: L1 acceptance time (ISO-8601). Distinct from any sender-supplied timestamp.

service.description: Canonical service name — fingerprint identity input.

severity_in.description: Source severity label, passed through un-normalized — fingerprint identity input.

title: Alert — canonical normalized alert (contract C2)
